notes: AICTE strictly mandates fee structure disclosures in their central database and mandatory disclosure PDFs.
AICTE directly allocates and monitors seat intake per program.
AICTE tracks NBA accreditation, but NAAC grades are tracked by the UGC/NAAC portal, requiring a secondary data source.
AICTE does not centrally host structured placement package statistics. This data is self-reported by colleges on their domains or via NIRF.
